name: SeedProd
summary: Drag-and-drop page and theme builder plugin for WordPress: landing pages, coming-soon and maintenance pages, full website kits and a theme builder, plus an AI builder that drafts a site from a description.
best_for: WordPress site owners and small businesses who want to build landing pages, coming-soon pages or a full theme with drag and drop instead of code
skip_if: you do not use WordPress and want a hosted builder that includes hosting, or you only want to pay the introductory price and not the full renewal
honest_knock: The prices on the pricing page are first-year discounts; renewals are at full price, which is double on most plans, and the terms say renewals are not refundable. It only works on WordPress, so you also need hosting and a WordPress install. The theme builder, needed for a full website rather than landing pages, starts on Plus.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · introductory first-year price, 1 site, normally $79 a year
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-04 on seedprod.com/pricing, US dollars) SeedProd is a WordPress plugin sold as a yearly licence, and the prices on the pricing page are introductory: the page says all renewals are at full price. Basic costs $39.50 for the first year, normally $79, for 1 site with 50 templates and the drag-and-drop builder. Plus costs $99.50, normally $199, for 3 sites and adds full website kits, the theme builder and email marketing integrations. Pro costs $199.50, normally $399, for 5 sites and adds 300+ templates, dynamic text, Zapier integrations and priority support. Elite costs $239.60, normally $599, for 100 sites and adds WooCommerce and Easy Digital Downloads support and domain mapping. Every licence comes with a 14-day money-back guarantee. Separately, the homepage offers an AI builder that creates up to 3 websites free, without a card.

schema_offer.description: Basic, introductory first-year price, 1 site, normally $79 a year; renewals at full price; Plus $99.50 (normally $199), Pro $199.50 (normally $399), Elite $239.60 (normally $599); 14-day money-back guarantee. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-04.

compare_with.name: Leadpages
compare_with.why: Leadpages is in our dossiers as a hosted landing-page builder: on 15 October 2026 Pro cost $29 a month ($23 billed annually) for 25 pages on 1 site, with no free plan. SeedProd runs inside your own WordPress site and charges a yearly licence instead, from $39.50 for the first year
